name: codex-project-flow
description: Install and safely upgrade a reusable Codex workflow with upstream-managed updates, protected project content, task barriers, and version handshakes.

interface.shortDescription: Bootstrap, upgrade, and reconcile a permanent project workflow.
interface.longDescription: Adopts a permanent coordination-only project hub, upgrades plugin-owned workflow content in favor of upstream while preserving declared project content, and reconciles active user-visible tasks through an upgrade barrier and exact version handshakes.
defaultPrompt: Use $bootstrap-project-flow in this saved local project to install the workflow and adopt this task as its permanent hub.
Use $upgrade-project-flow to apply a task-aware upgrade, prefer upstream for plugin-owned conflicts, preserve project content, and coordinate successors.
